collection.title: Glass Baby Bottles
collection.body_html: Discover the pure and sustainable choice for your baby's feeding journey. Our curated collection of glass baby bottles are crafted from thermal-shock resistant borosilicate glass, ensuring they are safe, durable, and easy to clean. Free from the chemicals sometimes found in plastic, glass offers ultimate peace of mind. Shop our range of ergonomic and stylish glass bottles from leading brands.

products.title: Glass Baby Bottle 150ml/240ml | Anti-Colic Wide Neck Feeding Bottle
products.body_html:
PREMIUM GLASS BABY BOTTLE FOR SAFE, HYGIENIC FEEDING

The Baby Glass Bottle provides a chemical-free feeding solution made from heat-resistant glass. Unlike plastic alternatives that retain odors and stains, this bottle maintains purity feed after feed. The 150ml and 240ml capacity options accommodate newborns through older infants.

Constructed from high-quality borosilicate glass, this feeding bottle withstands temperature fluctuations without cracking or warping. Parents can safely warm or cool milk while maintaining the bottle's structural integrity. The transparent glass allows easy monitoring of milk levels and cleanliness.

ANTI-COLIC DESIGN REDUCES GAS AND DISCOMFORT

The integrated vent system in the nipple minimizes air intake during feeding. This anti-colic feature helps reduce gas, spit-up, and fussiness. The wide caliber nipple mimics natural breastfeeding, supporting smooth transitions between breast and bottle.

The arc-shaped bottle design fits comfortably in adult hands and small baby grips. The wide neck opening simplifies filling, cleaning, and sterilization. Parents can thoroughly clean every corner without specialized brushes or tools.

DURABLE CONSTRUCTION FOR LONG-TERM USE

Glass construction eliminates chemical leaching concerns associated with plastic bottles. The material resists scratches, stains, and odor absorption, maintaining hygiene standards over extended use. The bottle withstands repeated sterilization cycles without degradation.

Available in blue and pink colors, the Baby Glass Bottle suits different preferences. The leak-proof cap system prevents spills during transport or storage. Each bottle measures 240 x 100 x 100 mm in packaging, making it convenient for diaper bags and travel.

SIMPLE MAINTENANCE AND CARE

1. Fill the bottle with prepared formula or expressed milk
2. Attach the anti-colic nipple and secure the cap
3. Feed at room temperature or gently warmed
4. Disassemble and sterilize all components after each use

The heat-resistant glass tolerates boiling water sterilization, steam sterilizers, and dishwasher cleaning. This versatility saves time while ensuring thorough sanitization between feedings.

PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS

Material: Glass
Capacity: 150ml and 240ml
Caliber: Wide caliber
Shape: Arc
Colors: Blue, Pink
Package Size: 240 x 100 x 100 mm

products.title: Glass Baby Bottle with Silicone Sleeve – Anti-Colic & Shatter-Resistant
products.body_html:
Baby Silicone Glass Feeding Bottle – Safe, Durable & Anti-Colic

The Baby Silicone Glass Feeding Bottle combines the purity of borosilicate glass with the protective durability of food-grade silicone. This feeding bottle addresses common parenting concerns with its anti-fall protection and anti-colic vent system, reducing gas, spit-ups, and feeding discomfort for your baby.

Premium Materials for Safe Feeding

Constructed from premium borosilicate glass wrapped in soft, food-grade silicone, this bottle offers multiple safety benefits. The glass interior ensures no chemical leaching into milk or formula, while the silicone sleeve provides shock absorption and grip. The bottle is BPA-free, heat-resistant, and shatter-resistant, making it safe for sterilization and daily use.

Anti-Colic Vent System

The integrated anti-colic vent system works by reducing air intake during feeding. This design helps minimize gas buildup, colic symptoms, and spit-ups, creating a more comfortable feeding experience for your baby and less stress for parents.

Practical Design Features

The wide-neck opening simplifies bottle preparation and cleaning. Parents can easily add formula or breast milk, and the opening accommodates standard bottle brushes for thorough cleaning. The soft silicone grip ensures comfortable handling during feeding sessions, whether held by parents or older babies learning to self-feed.

Durable & Long-Lasting

The shatter-resistant construction means this bottle can withstand drops and bumps that occur during daily use. The silicone sleeve absorbs impact, protecting the glass interior and extending the bottle's lifespan. Heat-resistant materials allow for safe sterilization in boiling water, steam sterilizers, or dishwashers.

Key Features:

  • Durable glass bottle with soft silicone cover
  • Anti-fall & shatter-resistant for added safety
  • Anti-colic vent system reduces gas & spit-ups
  • BPA-free, heat-resistant & food-grade materials
  • Wide-neck design for easy cleaning & filling

A practical, safe, and long-lasting feeding solution for your growing baby.

products.title: Nibby Glass Baby Bottle – Thermostatic Anti-Colic Feeding Bottle
products.body_html:
Nibby Portable Glass Baby Bottle – Thermostatic Milk Storage & Feeding Bottle

The Nibby Portable Glass Baby Bottle is the perfect blend of safety, durability, and smart feeding design. Made from high-quality borosilicate glass, this bottle ensures safe milk storage and long-lasting use, even under high temperatures.

With its thermostatic function, the Nibby bottle helps maintain the right milk temperature, making feeding time more convenient for parents and comfortable for babies. Its anti-colic nipple mimics natural breastfeeding to reduce gas, spit-up, and fussiness.

Lightweight, portable, and easy to clean, this glass baby bottle is ideal for home use or travel, giving parents peace of mind and infants a safe, natural feeding experience.

Key Features:

  • Premium Glass Material: Durable, heat-resistant borosilicate glass.
  • Thermostatic Storage: Maintains milk at a safe, warm temperature.
  • Anti-Colic Nipple: Natural breastfeeding feel to reduce discomfort.
  • Portable Design: Easy to carry for travel and on-the-go feeding.
  • Safe & Hygienic: BPA-free and easy to sterilize.

Why Choose Borosilicate Glass?

Borosilicate glass is thermal shock resistant and can withstand rapid temperature changes without breaking. This makes the Nibby bottle safe for warming, sterilizing, and storing breast milk or formula. Unlike plastic bottles, glass doesn't absorb odors or colors and maintains hygiene over time.

Thermostatic Temperature Control

The built-in thermostatic function keeps milk at the optimal feeding temperature, reducing the need for constant reheating and making nighttime feedings easier. Parents can prepare bottles in advance knowing the milk will stay at the right warmth for their baby.

Anti-Colic Design for Comfortable Feeding

The specially designed anti-colic nipple allows air to flow into the bottle instead of into your baby's stomach, reducing colic symptoms, gas, and discomfort. The nipple shape mimics natural breastfeeding to support easy latch and smooth feeding transitions.

Travel-Ready and Convenient

Compact and portable, the Nibby glass baby bottle fits easily into diaper bags and cup holders. The secure lid prevents leaks during travel, making it perfect for outings, daycare, or visits to grandparents.

Choose the Nibby Portable Glass Baby Bottle for safe, stress-free, and natural feeding every day.

products.title: SnugNest Glass Baby Bottle – Drop-Resistant Straw Feeder
products.body_html:
Drop-Resistant Glass Baby Bottle with Straw Nipple

The SnugNest Drop-Resistant Glass Baby Bottle is designed for safe and stress-free feeding. Made from premium borosilicate glass, it offers superior durability while resisting drops and temperature changes. Perfect for both milk and water feeding, this bottle ensures your baby's comfort and safety.

Equipped with a soft straw nipple, it mimics natural breastfeeding and makes sipping easier for newborns and toddlers. Its anti-colic design reduces gas, spit-up, and fussiness, while the ergonomic shape allows little hands to hold it with ease.

Why Choose Borosilicate Glass?

Borosilicate glass is heat-resistant, thermal shock-proof, and doesn't retain odors or stains. Unlike plastic bottles, it won't leach chemicals into your baby's milk or water, making it a safer choice for daily feeding.

Anti-Colic Straw System

The integrated straw nipple design helps prevent air intake during feeding, significantly reducing colic symptoms, gas buildup, and digestive discomfort. The soft silicone straw is gentle on developing gums and teeth.

Built to Last

Easy to clean, hygienic, and built to last, the SnugNest glass baby bottle is an excellent choice for parents looking for a safe, eco-friendly, and reliable feeding solution. The drop-resistant construction withstands daily use, while the wide mouth opening makes cleaning and filling simple.

Key Features:

  • Drop-Resistant Glass: Durable, heat-resistant borosilicate material.
  • Straw Nipple Design: Comfortable feeding for newborns & toddlers.
  • Anti-Colic System: Prevents gas and feeding discomfort.
  • Multi-Use Feeder: Suitable for both milk and water.
  • Safe & Easy to Clean: BPA-free, eco-friendly, and hygienic.

Give your little one safe and natural feeding with the SnugNest Drop-Resistant Glass Baby Bottle.
